2424:ETF_TLH:PAIRS_TLH.explanation: We first tried to rebalance (i.e. allow selling), but did not suggest any orders at that step, which said that we will not trade because the suggested orders cause an improvement that is too small; it is less than the threshold of 200.0 and in this case were are only buying and not selling, so there is nothing to do. We then tried to see if it's worth just investing (i.e. with selling disallowed), which said that we will not trade because the suggested orders cause an improvement that is too small; it is less than the threshold of 10.0 and in this case were are only buying and not selling, so there is nothing to do.
